headline: Weekly condor +1.89%/wk per margin (80% hit) but one full-wing wipe (Budget wk 2016-02-29) makes per-unit-margin compounding RUIN vs monthly +13.96%/yr geo; daily close-stop can't cap gap weeks.

caveats: BS paper sim, VIX-flat vol, r=0.06, no bid-ask/txn costs/SPAN (margin proxy = max loss). Entry declared in script header: VIXpct>=0.6 (F16 threshold) OR storm(|ret|>=2%) within 5td; strikes 1.0/2.5-sigma at entry close; close-only marks, so the daily stop cannot see intraday gaps yet its stopped arm still compounds to -28.96%/yr. Arithmetic per-unit means favor weekly (+37.4 vs +21.3%/yr uncompounded): the weekly-vs-monthly compounding claim is SIZING-dependent, not frequency-dependent — one 2.5-sigma wing breach (2016-02-29 Budget week; next worst 2020-02-24 COVID -93%, 2016-02-08 -92%) wipes a full-margin weekly compounder while the monthly worst is -75.6%. Feeds F18 Kelly/ruin math. Sample 2011-07-26..2023-04-05 (VIX pct min_obs=252).
